name: dsh-sci
description: Zero-dependency DeepSeek Harness host tool set for quantitative work: dimension-aware physical unit conversion, CODATA 2022 constant lookup, and Runge-Kutta ODE integration of small systems whose right-hand side is parsed by a hand-written locked-down interpreter (no eval).

plugin.note: Host-plane tool plugin, zero runtime dependencies: deterministic pure computation on arguments only (no I/O, no network), so it needs no configuration and no credentials.
